content.user_title: Publish Google ADK Agents to Gemini Enterprise
content.value_statement: Publishing ADK agents to Gemini Enterprise requires the correct registration mode, resource IDs, and permissions. This skill guides Claude, Codex, or Claude Code through safe CLI registration and Agent Registry management.
actual_capabilities: Explains ADK and A2A registration modes for Gemini Enterprise.
Maps publish command flags to supported environment variables.
Guides interactive and non-interactive publication workflows.
Covers Agent Registry list, inspect, update, and delete tasks.
Troubleshoots registration, permission, and SDK compatibility issues.
limitations: It does not deploy agents; deployment uses a separate skill.
It requires agents-cli and valid Google Cloud permissions.
It does not create Gemini Enterprise apps for the user.
It cannot verify live project state without authorized CLI access.

use_cases.title: Register a deployed ADK agent
use_cases.description: Publish an existing Agent Runtime deployment to a Gemini Enterprise app with the correct resource names.

use_cases.title: Automate production registration
use_cases.description: Build a non-interactive publish flow for CI/CD using flags or environment variables.

use_cases.title: Manage registered agent records
use_cases.description: List, inspect, update, or remove agents through Agent Registry guidance.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a first publish
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner setup for a deployed ADK agent.
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me publish my deployed ADK agent to Gemini Enterprise. Ask for the missing app ID, runtime ID, display name, and registration type.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare CI registration
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a non-interactive publish plan for a CI pipeline. Use environment variables and include validation steps before running the command.

prompt_templates.title: Register an A2A agent
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced Cloud Run or Agent Runtime registration.
prompt_templates.prompt: I have an A2A agent on Cloud Run. Help me register it with Gemini Enterprise, including agent card URL, permissions, and troubleshooting checks.

prompt_templates.title: Review registry operations
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me inspect and update existing Agent Registry entries. Identify safe checks before changing endpoints, metadata, or deleting records.

output_examples.input: I have a deployed Agent Runtime agent and a Gemini Enterprise app ID.
output_examples.output: The assistant identifies ADK registration, checks required IDs, and prepares a publish sequence with display name and description fields.

output_examples.input: My A2A Cloud Run registration cannot fetch the agent card.
output_examples.output: The assistant reviews the agent card URL, Cloud Run invoker role, authentication state, and project permissions before suggesting retry steps.

output_examples.input: I need to clean up an old registered agent.
output_examples.output: The assistant distinguishes auto-registered runtime agents from manual Service records and recommends inspection before any delete action.

best_practices: Confirm the target project, location, app ID, and registration mode before publishing.
Use deployment metadata only after verifying it belongs to the intended deployment.
Inspect Agent Registry records before updating endpoints or deleting services.
anti_patterns: Publishing with guessed resource IDs or unclear registration type.
Sharing production project IDs, app IDs, or authorization IDs in public examples.
Deleting Agent Registry services without checking runtime ownership first.

faq.question: Does this skill deploy agents?
faq.answer: No. It only covers publication and registration after deployment. Use the deploy skill for deployment workflows.

faq.question: Which registration modes are covered?
faq.answer: It covers ADK registration and A2A registration for supported Gemini Enterprise publishing flows.

faq.question: Can it run in CI/CD?
faq.answer: Yes. It explains non-interactive usage through flags and supported environment variables.

faq.question: Does it support Agent Registry management?
faq.answer: Yes. It covers listing, inspecting, updating, and removing registered agent records through Google Cloud tooling.

faq.question: What permissions are needed?
faq.answer: Permissions depend on the workflow. A2A Cloud Run registration needs the Discovery Engine service account to invoke the service.

faq.question: What should I check before republishing?
faq.answer: Confirm the target app, registration mode, metadata file, and agent description. Republishing can update an existing registration.
